memberdef.name: DECLARE_FORMAT_ITEM
memberdef.initializer: {\ QFont font = f; \ QColor color = c; \ m_formats.insert( type, qMakePair(QString(id), new Q3TextFormat(font, color)) ); \ }

memberdef.name: UPDATE_FORMAT_ITEM
memberdef.initializer: m_formats[ type ].second->setFont( f ); \ m_formats[ type ].second->setColor( c );

memberdef.name: STORE_FORMAT_ITEM
memberdef.initializer: {\ QString id = m_formats[ type ].first; \ Q3TextFormat* fmt = m_formats[ type ].second; \ }
